_comment: Service conditions a requirement may depend on (#638, #677). Read by
app/service_scope.py. A requirement is SPECIFIC to a condition when its
standard is one of `standards` (read by standard_ids, so any spelling and
the equivalent names match) or its own text carries one of
`requirement_markers`. It does NOT APPLY only when the submittal's own
datasheet DECLARES the condition absent: a field whose label carries one
of `field_labels` and whose value reads as `declared_absent`. Declared
present, or not declared at all, keeps the requirement a check - unknown
is never 'does not apply'. Edit this file to add a condition; no code
